title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat in the Queues app Recap tab for recorded call queue calls
summary: Hold: the briefing treats recording-access settings as confirmed controls over who can query Copilot, but Microsoft documents recording access and Copilot availability separately. Its checklist also directs administrators to recording templates to list call queues, whereas Microsoft documents template assignment on each call queue.

claims.claim: This change adds Copilot Chat to the Queues app Recap tab for recorded call queue calls.
claims.quote: Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab.
